segments.ja403:1.1: Yeme ahaṃ na jānāmi, aṭṭhisena vanibbake;
segments.ja403:1.3: Te maṃ saṅgamma yācanti, kasmā maṃ tvaṃ na yācasi.
segments.ja403:2.3: Tasmāhaṃ taṃ na yācāmi, mā me videssanā [viddesanā (sī. pī.)] ahu.
segments.ja403:3.1: Yo ve yācanajīvāno, kāle yācaṃ na yācati;
segments.ja403:3.3: Parañca puññā [puññaṃ (syā. ka.)] dhaṃseti, attanāpi na jīvati.
segments.ja403:4.1: Yo ca [yo ve (ka.)] yācanajīvāno, kāle yācañhi yācati [yācaṃpi yācati (syā.), yācāni yācati (pī.), yācati yācanaṃ (sī. niyya), yācanaṃ yācati (ka.)];
segments.ja403:4.3: Parañca puññaṃ labbheti, attanāpi ca jīvati.
segments.ja403:5.1: Na ve dessanti [na ve dussanti (syā.), na ve dissanti (pī.), na videssanti (ka. aṭṭha.)] sappaññā, disvā yācakamāgate;
segments.ja403:5.3: Brahmacāri piyo mesi, vada tvaṃ [vara taṃ (sī.), vara tvaṃ (pī.)] bhaññamicchasi [yaññamicchasi (?)].
segments.ja403:6.1: Na ve yācanti sappaññā, dhīro ca veditumarahati;
segments.ja403:6.3: Uddissa ariyā tiṭṭhanti, esā ariyāna yācanā.
segments.ja403:7.1: Dadāmi te brāhmaṇa rohiṇīnaṃ, gavaṃ sahassaṃ saha puṅgavena;
segments.ja403:7.3: Ariyo hi ariyassa kathaṃ na dajjā, sutvāna gāthā tava dhammayuttāti.
